title: console: the record create/edit dialog shows only "You don't have permission to save this record." on a controlled_by_parent master-edit refusal, dropping the API's reason ("requires edit access to its master record"); #7366 regression on this path
body:
repo:hotcrm#1 · huangyiirene · session_01J8VVAnPkgK6CWrJa6t7Fk5

## What happens (@objectstack 18.4.0, measured by HotCRM's Order to Cash browser pass on 2026-11-14)

A user who reads a contract but does not edit it opens the create dialog of a `controlled_by_parent` detail (HotCRM `crm_billing_milestone`, `crm_invoice`) and saves. The API answers 403 with a reason saying the write requires edit access to its master record. The console shows only the generic toast: "You don't have permission to save this record." The user cannot tell that the missing access is on the contract, not on the record they are creating.

#7366 (closed) fixed "Console discards the server error message on 403". This path either does not take that fix or has regressed.

## Ask

On a 403 whose envelope carries a `userMessage` (or a master-chain reason), the create and edit dialogs show it, as they do for other refusals.

## Acceptance

1. A master-edit refusal on create shows the server's reason, naming the master object, in the dialog or toast, in en and zh-CN.
2. The same applies on edit.
3. A refusal with no userMessage keeps the generic line.
